title: Custom Battery warning level - DIY transmitters
symptom: The battery warning time is very short, max 8h or if unlucky to have it discharge between battery checks, because the transmitter receives 3.7v from a rechargeable LiPo battery and the voltage warning level is fixed at 290.
cause: The battery warning level is hardcoded to 290, which is too low for DIY transmitters using a 3.7v LiPo battery, resulting in short warning time.
fix: The feature was implemented in the 22nd Jan Nightly. Users can go to Settings -> G5 Debug Settings -> Adjust battery warning level and change it to the desired level.
settings_changed: Adjust battery warning level → user-defined level
evidence_quote: This should be present in the 22nd Jan Nightly. Look in `Settings` -> `G5 Debug Settings` -> `Adjust battery warning level` and change it to the level you want to receive alerts at.
